papers.title: SceneFun3D
papers.data: 710 high-resolution real-world indoor scenes with 14.8k functional interaction annotations, affordance labels, motion parameters, and task-language descriptions
papers.method: large-scale 3D functionality annotation plus functionality segmentation, task-driven affordance grounding, and 3D motion estimation baselines
papers.task: identify functional interactive elements, ground language tasks to affordance masks, and infer interaction motion parameters
papers.novelty: moves 3D scene understanding from object-level semantics to actionable functional elements in real scanned indoor scenes
papers.project_relevance: Defines reusable fields Object, Part, Affordance, FunctionalElement, TaskLanguage, MotionParameter for our typed interactive-world representation.

papers.title: BEHAVIOR-1K
papers.data: 1000 everyday activities, 50 scenes, more than 9000 objects, BDDL task predicates, and OmniGibson simulation support
papers.method: human-centered task benchmark with formal predicate/task definitions and realistic simulator-backed execution
papers.task: long-horizon household activity execution and evaluation in simulation
papers.novelty: scales executable household tasks with semantic and physical properties, including rigid bodies, deformables, and liquids
papers.project_relevance: Directly informs Task, StatePredicate, GoalCondition, SceneObject, PhysicalProperty, and validation protocol design.

papers.title: PhysX-Omni
papers.data: PhysXVerse plus PhysX-Bench for geometry, scale, material, affordance, kinematics, and function description across rigid, deformable, and articulated objects
papers.method: VLM-oriented physical 3D generation with an efficient geometry representation and benchmarked physical attribute understanding
papers.task: generate simulation-ready physical 3D assets and evaluate physical/functional attributes
papers.novelty: unifies rigid, deformable, and articulated physical 3D generation instead of treating them as separate asset categories
papers.project_relevance: Strong candidate for PhysicalProperty, Material, DeformableState, KinematicJoint, and simulator export fields.

papers.title: PhysDreamer
papers.data: static 3D objects, video-diffusion dynamics priors, material-field estimates, and interaction examples for elastic objects
papers.method: distills video generation priors into a physical material field and uses physics simulation to synthesize action-conditioned object dynamics
papers.task: make static 3D objects respond to external forces or manipulation in physically plausible ways
papers.novelty: uses video-generation dynamics priors to estimate material behavior for interactive 3D object simulation
papers.project_relevance: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

papers.title: Feature Splatting
papers.data: 3D Gaussian scenes with distilled foundation-model features, text-grounded decomposition, material queries, and physics-simulation examples
papers.method: feature-bearing 3D Gaussians plus text-query segmentation and particle-based physics simulation with automatically assigned material properties
papers.task: language-driven physics-based scene synthesis, editing, and material-aware simulation
papers.novelty: turns 3DGS from a visual representation into a semantic/material/physics-aware editing and simulation substrate
papers.project_relevance: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

papers.title: PhysX-Anything
papers.data: PhysX-Mobility with 2K+ common objects plus in-the-wild single-image inputs and physical/articulation annotations
papers.method: VLM-based physical 3D generative model with efficient geometry tokenization and explicit geometry, articulation, and physical attributes
papers.task: generate simulation-ready physical 3D assets from a single image
papers.novelty: turns image-conditioned 3D generation into sim-ready assets with physical and articulation metadata
papers.project_relevance: Strong object-level source for PhysicalProperty, KinematicJoint, AssetToSimulator, and contact-rich policy-learning validation.

papers.title: SimuScene
papers.data: single-image compositional 3D scene reconstruction benchmarks plus humanoid and robot-arm downstream deployments
papers.method: physics-in-the-loop compositional reconstruction that converts simulation failures into shape/layout correction signals
papers.task: reconstruct stable simulation-ready 3D scenes from one image
papers.novelty: uses physics simulation as a diagnostic measurement tool during generation rather than only post-hoc cleanup
papers.project_relevance: Relevant to SceneTree, SupportRelation, PhysicalViolation, and simulator-ready reconstruction validators.

papers.title: REST3D
papers.data: synthetic and real-world single-RGB-image reconstruction datasets, Isaac Gym simulation checks, and VR interaction demos
papers.method: agentic physical scene understanding, scene-tree construction, image-to-3D initialization, and physics-constrained refinement
papers.task: reconstruct physically stable interactive 3D scenes from a single RGB image
papers.novelty: uses gravity-support scene trees as structural priors for stable scene reconstruction
papers.project_relevance: Provides a useful template for SceneTree, SupportGraph, StabilityCheck, and PhysicsRefinement stages.

papers.title: TriSplat
papers.data: RealEstate10K, DL3DV, ScanNet-style sparse-view reconstruction evaluations
papers.method: feed-forward oriented-triangle splatting network that predicts point maps, triangle attributes, camera poses, and mesh-ready surfaces
papers.task: reconstruct simulation-ready mesh scenes from sparse or pose-free images
papers.novelty: replaces Gaussian primitives with oriented triangle primitives that can be ingested by physics/rendering pipelines without post-hoc meshing
papers.project_relevance: Useful representation reference for MeshScene, CollisionSurface, and feed-forward sim-ready reconstruction.

papers.title: SceneCode: Editable Indoor Scene Generation using Executable World Programs
papers.data: indoor scene layouts and hierarchical scene-program examples covering generation, reconstruction, and editing
papers.method: hierarchical executable scene program that decomposes floor plans, rooms, and objects for editable scene generation
papers.task: generate, reconstruct, and edit indoor scenes through executable world programs
papers.novelty: treats indoor scene generation as structured executable program synthesis rather than opaque scene decoding
papers.project_relevance: Strong representation reference for structured world code, room-level decomposition, and local indoor-scene edits.

papers.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
papers.data: single-image action examples spanning rigid, elastic, cloth, smoke, liquid and granular materials
papers.method: Gaussian-surfels reconstruction, material-specific physics solvers, video generation and differentiable 3D state refinement
papers.task: generate action-conditioned dynamic 3D scenes across material types
papers.novelty: closes the loop between explicit coarse multi-material physics and generative video refinement
papers.project_relevance: Executable-world reference for typed materials, forces and hybrid simulated/generated state.

papers.title: PhyScene
papers.data: 3D scene layouts, 3D-FRONT / ProcTHOR conditions, articulated GAPartNet assets, and Isaac Sim interaction examples
papers.method: conditional diffusion scene layout generation guided by collision, room-layout, and reachability/interactivity constraints
papers.task: synthesize physically plausible and interactable 3D indoor scenes for embodied agents
papers.novelty: adds physical and agent-interaction guidance to scene synthesis rather than optimizing only visual/layout naturalness
papers.project_relevance: Baseline for InteractionConstraint, Reachability, Collision, Articulation, and GeneratedScene validity metrics.

papers.title: RoboGen
papers.data: automatically generated tasks, scenes, training supervisions, demonstrations, and learned robotic skills in simulation
papers.method: propose-generate-learn loop using foundation/generative models, task decomposition, scene generation, supervision generation, and policy learning
papers.task: automated generation of robot learning tasks and policy training data
papers.novelty: closes the loop from task proposal to simulated environment to training supervision and learned skill
papers.project_relevance: Directly motivates TaskGenerator, SceneGenerator, SupervisionGenerator, PolicyLearner, and validation-loop abstractions.

papers.title: Steerable Scene Generation
papers.data: over 44M procedurally generated SE(3) scene placements
papers.method: diffusion scene prior steered by RL, conditioning and MCTS
papers.task: generate scenes satisfying task and physical objectives
papers.novelty: combines PCG-scale data with inference-time search and downstream steering
papers.project_relevance: strong baseline for task-constrained scene generation

papers.title: SAGE
papers.data: SAGE-10k task-conditioned synthetic scenes and generated objects
papers.method: agentic PCG with semantic, visual and physical critics
papers.task: task-conditioned indoor scene generation for embodied AI
papers.novelty: uses critics and iterative tool selection to improve simulator-ready scenes
papers.project_relevance: closest PCG baseline; it can use a typed interaction representation as I/O and evaluator

papers.title: EmbodiedGen
papers.data: 3D assets, articulated objects, scene and layout generation modules
papers.method: generative 3D world engine for embodied intelligence
papers.task: generate interactive 3D worlds and assets
papers.novelty: packages multiple generative modules for embodied world construction
papers.project_relevance: generation engine that can consume or be evaluated by a typed interactive-world representation

papers.title: Holodeck
papers.data: language prompts, Objaverse assets, AI2-THOR environments, human evaluations, and NoveltyTHOR navigation benchmark
papers.method: LLM-driven environment generation with spatial relational constraints, asset retrieval, layout optimization, and AI2-THOR integration
papers.task: generate customized 3D embodied AI environments from natural language
papers.novelty: uses LLM commonsense plus constraint optimization to generate diverse interactive AI2-THOR environments from open-ended prompts
papers.project_relevance: Important baseline for Prompt, SceneSpec, SpatialConstraint, AssetRetrieval, LayoutOptimization, and downstream embodied evaluation.

papers.title: Infinigen Indoors
papers.data: fully procedural indoor scenes, furniture, architecture elements, appliances, and dense synthetic labels from Blender
papers.method: procedural indoor asset and layout generation with a constraint DSL and solver for scene composition
papers.task: generate photorealistic indoor scenes and annotations for vision/embodied research
papers.novelty: extends Infinigen from natural worlds to indoor procedural scenes with real geometry and controllable annotations
papers.project_relevance: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.

papers.title: SceneSmith
papers.data: text-prompted indoor scenes, generated static assets, retrieved articulated objects, physical properties, and example scene dataset
papers.method: hierarchical agentic text-to-scene framework with designer, critic, and orchestrator VLM agents across layout, furniture, and object-population stages
papers.task: generate dense simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts
papers.novelty: combines agentic generation with physical property estimation and policy-evaluation-ready scene export
papers.project_relevance: Top PCG baseline for PromptToScene, CriticLoop, ObjectPopulation, PhysicalProperty, and policy evaluation.

papers.title: SceneFoundry
papers.data: apartment-scale generated 3D worlds with articulated assets from large-scale repositories
papers.method: language-guided diffusion with LLM floor-plan control, posterior sampling for object population, articulation-collision and walkability guidance
papers.task: generate large-scale interactive and physically usable indoor 3D worlds
papers.novelty: focuses on functionally articulated furniture and apartment-scale interactive world generation
papers.project_relevance: Relevant PCG line for LayoutConstraint, ArticulationConstraint, WalkableSpace, and infinite-world expansion.

papers.title: HY-World 2.0
papers.data: text, single-view, multi-view, and video inputs; generated 3DGS/mesh worlds; released model weights and code
papers.method: four-stage world pipeline with panorama generation, trajectory planning, world expansion, reconstruction, and WorldLens rendering
papers.task: reconstruct, generate, and simulate navigable 3D worlds from multimodal inputs
papers.novelty: unifies generation and reconstruction for explorable 3D worlds with open weights/code
papers.project_relevance: Strong open-source world-generation baseline for WorldRepresentation, TrajectoryPlan, 3DGSScene, MeshExport, and engine integration.

papers.title: SimWorld Studio: Generation and Evolution of Custom Embodied Agent Learning Environments
papers.data: benchmark suite with 320 embodied tasks and 240 held-out layouts plus generated and evolved environment examples
papers.method: environment generation-and-evolution loop that refines embodied learning worlds from user goals and feedback
papers.task: generate and iteratively evolve custom embodied learning environments
papers.novelty: extends embodied environment generation into an explicit closed-loop evolution process rather than one-shot PCG output
papers.project_relevance: Strong PCG baseline for custom embodied worlds, curriculum generation, and iterative environment refinement.

papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.data: sim-ready asset, scene, and task-world generation pipeline with public Hugging Face collection and dataset for cross-simulator embodied world construction.
papers.method: unified generative world engine that composes sim-ready assets, editable scenes, task-driven worlds, dialogue-based state editing, and cross-simulator export into one closed-loop pipeline.
papers.task: turn text, images, and dialogue instructions into executable multi-room 3D worlds that can be deployed across major simulators for embodied learning.
papers.novelty: pushes embodied world generation from isolated assets toward a reusable, agentic world engine that keeps affordances, state, layout stability, and simulator interfaces aligned.
papers.project_relevance: Very strong fit for the repository’s interactive generation branch because it connects asset generation, affordance/state retention, and executable world assembly.

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.data: Nearly 20K interactive scenes and more than 10M generated navigation samples from posed RGB-D imagery.
papers.method: Feature-Gaussian anchoring plus geometry-aware one-step panoramic RGB-D rendering, motion simulation, and automatic action/instruction annotation.
papers.task: Build real-time interactive neural navigation environments and scalable training data from captured imagery.
papers.novelty: Decouples 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis to turn image collections into executable simulators.
papers.project_relevance: Direct baseline for image-to-interactive-world generation, navigability, and action-aligned data creation.

papers.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
papers.data: single images with user camera/content controls across natural and built environments
papers.method: Fast Layered Gaussian Surfels, text outpainting and guided depth diffusion
papers.task: incrementally generate connected user-steered 3D worlds
papers.novelty: low-latency connected 3D scene expansion under online camera and content control
papers.project_relevance: Direct baseline for interactive world building and latency-aware PCG.

papers.title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
papers.data: Single-image indoor/outdoor scenes, camera trajectories, and long-video evaluations shown on the official project page.
papers.method: Point-anchored Sparse Structure Flow generates a global 3D proxy, followed by proxy-conditioned video diffusion appearance refinement.
papers.task: Generate controllable, explorable, long-horizon scene videos from a single image.
papers.novelty: Uses a generative global 3D proxy as persistent structure and spatial memory to reduce drift during chunked exploration.
papers.project_relevance: Strong reference for persistent 3D memory, controllable camera trajectories, and structure/appearance separation in interactive generation.

papers.title: SpatialBot
papers.data: SpatialQA and RGB-D spatial-understanding benchmark data
papers.method: RGB-D vision-language model for precise spatial understanding
papers.task: spatial VQA and embodied AI tasks
papers.novelty: feeds both RGB and depth to improve metric spatial reasoning
papers.project_relevance: supports grounding spatial relations from observations

papers.title: HiSpatial
papers.data: about 5M images and over 45M objects converted into 3D spatial VQA pairs
papers.method: hierarchical 3D spatial understanding pipeline and VLM fine-tuning
papers.task: 3D spatial relation and reasoning benchmarks
papers.novelty: large-scale hierarchical spatial supervision for VLMs
papers.project_relevance: useful for spatial relation completion and validation

papers.title: SpaceTools
papers.data: Toolshed infrastructure and spatial reasoning benchmarks such as RoboSpatial-Home, BLINK and BOP-ask
papers.method: tool-augmented spatial reasoning with Double Interactive Reinforcement Learning
papers.task: metric spatial reasoning and robot tool use
papers.novelty: lets VLMs call vision and robotic tools for precise spatial answers
papers.project_relevance: prototype for target-task validators that invoke measurement/simulation tools

papers.title: Ego3D-Bench / Ego3D-VLM
papers.data: over 8600 egocentric multi-view outdoor spatial QA pairs
papers.method: cognitive-map based post-training using estimated global 3D coordinates
papers.task: multi-view egocentric spatial reasoning
papers.novelty: evaluates embodied multi-view spatial reasoning beyond single images
papers.project_relevance: supports Scene coordinate-frame and relation grounding

papers.title: Seeing Across Views / MV-RoboBench
papers.data: multi-view robotic manipulation scenes with spatial QA
papers.method: benchmarking multi-view spatial reasoning of VLMs in robotic scenes
papers.task: spatial and robotic reasoning across synchronized camera views
papers.novelty: shows single-view spatial reasoning does not transfer reliably to robotic multi-view settings
papers.project_relevance: important benchmark for observation-to-scene-graph parsing

papers.title: SpatialVLA
papers.data: 1.1M real robot episodes and evaluations across 7 robot learning scenarios, 16 real-robot tasks, and 48 simulation setups
papers.method: VLA with 3D Ego3D position encoding and adaptive spatial action grids for spatial action token prediction
papers.task: spatially grounded generalist manipulation and spatial-prompt execution
papers.novelty: injects explicit 3D spatial context and adaptive action grids into VLA policy learning
papers.project_relevance: Useful for Scene.spatial_graph, Ego3DEncoding, SpatialActionToken, and spatial instruction validation.

papers.title: DepthVLA
papers.data: real-world, LIBERO and Simpler evaluations
papers.method: mixture-of-transformers combining VLM, depth transformer and action expert
papers.task: depth-aware language-conditioned manipulation
papers.novelty: adds explicit depth reasoning to VLA with strong real and sim gains
papers.project_relevance: supports depth-based scene grounding and precise spatial action

papers.title: ST-VLA
papers.data: ST-Human with 14 tasks and 300k episodes plus RLBench and real-world tasks
papers.method: 3D-4D representation, spatial masks and spatiotemporal VLM
papers.task: open-world long-horizon robot manipulation
papers.novelty: bridges semantic reasoning and continuous control through 4D spatial context
papers.project_relevance: points to temporal/deformable state and trajectory grounding

papers.title: SpatialStack
papers.data: multiple 3D spatial reasoning benchmarks and VLM-SpatialStack training/evaluation data
papers.method: layered geometry-language fusion that injects multi-level geometric features into a VLM hierarchy
papers.task: 3D spatial reasoning for embodied and physical AI systems
papers.novelty: moves beyond late-stage geometry fusion by stacking hierarchical geometric signals through the language backbone
papers.project_relevance: Good spatial encoder/validator reference for local geometry, global context, and relation checking in generated worlds.

papers.title: Embodied3DBench
papers.data: robot-centric embodied 3D benchmark with 6 task categories, 12 subcategories, 21k+ QA pairs, and a 1.3M-pair synthetic training set
papers.method: diagnostic benchmark plus synthetic QA training data for low-level embodied spatial intelligence
papers.task: benchmark low-level embodied spatial understanding and interaction-oriented perception for VLMs
papers.novelty: separates structural spatial understanding from interaction-oriented perception and pairs diagnosis with a large synthetic improvement set
papers.project_relevance: Useful low-level benchmark for grounding, affordance, grasp-point, and trajectory-perception checks in generated or reconstructed worlds.

papers.title: ESPIRE
papers.data: Isaac-Sim-based embodied spatial reasoning benchmark with 148 localization reasoning types and functional-program-generated scene-graph targets
papers.method: fully generative localization-plus-execution benchmark for embodied spatial reasoning in simulation
papers.task: diagnose action-oriented embodied spatial reasoning of VLMs under physically grounded execution settings
papers.novelty: turns spatial reasoning evaluation from static QA into a physically grounded generative localization and execution problem
papers.project_relevance: Strong validator template for reasoning-to-act spatial competence in interactive embodied generation systems.

papers.title: SpatialAct: Probing Spatial Reasoning-to-Action Capabilities of Vision-Language Models in 3D Scenes
papers.data: 333 synthetic 3D scenes and 4,355 QA pairs across three reasoning-to-action task categories
papers.method: 3D-scene benchmark with tool-based repair analysis for spatial reasoning-to-action
papers.task: evaluate whether VLM spatial reasoning is useful for action-grounded decisions in 3D scenes
papers.novelty: bridges spatial QA and action-grounded reasoning with a diagnostic repair stage and 3D benchmark design
papers.project_relevance: Strong validator for action-grounded spatial reasoning in generated or reconstructed worlds.

papers.title: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
papers.data: OmniGibson-grounded benchmark with 10 task categories, 29 subcategories, and 3,081 embodied spatial questions that require perception, locomotion, and manipulation decisions.
papers.method: recasts spatial intelligence as an active perception-action loop, evaluates embodied agents under controlled task families, and measures gains from active exploration versus passive observation.
papers.task: answer embodied spatial questions that require choosing how to move, inspect, and manipulate the environment to uncover hidden spatial facts.
papers.novelty: moves spatial intelligence benchmarking from passive or oracle-view settings into an embodied action loop where the agent must actively gather the evidence needed for reasoning.
papers.project_relevance: Strong benchmark reference for whether generated or reconstructed worlds preserve the active spatial structure needed for embodied decision-making.

papers.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
papers.data: 4,856 QA pairs across 13 tasks from 1,646 real UAV videos (about 14.9 hours), with dual-expert verification and public code/data.
papers.method: self-in-space evaluation hierarchy spanning spatial cognition, self-motion awareness, perception, memory, and reasoning, plus an optical-flow-aware SIS-Motion baseline
papers.task: evaluate whether video MLLMs jointly model external spatial structure and the UAV's own evolving motion/action state
papers.novelty: makes agent self-state explicit alongside environmental spatial cognition in aerial embodied evaluation
papers.project_relevance: Provides reusable AgentState, MotionHistory, SpatialMemory, ActionPrediction, and PathPlanning evaluation fields.

papers.title: Point-It-Out: Benchmarking Embodied Reasoning for Vision Language Models in Multi-Stage Visual Grounding
papers.data: 600+ human-annotated box, point, and visual-trace QA pairs across household, kitchen, driving, and robot manipulation scenarios
papers.method: three-stage pixel-level benchmark for referred-object localization, task-driven pointing, and visual trace prediction
papers.task: evaluate whether VLMs convert embodied reasoning into precise spatial grounding and action traces
papers.novelty: replaces indirect multiple-choice embodied reasoning tests with a hierarchical box-to-point-to-trajectory grounding protocol
papers.project_relevance: Provides reusable GroundingStage, TargetBox, ActionPoint, and VisualTrace fields for spatial-to-action evaluation.

papers.title: Octo
papers.data: 800k robot episodes from 25 Open X-Embodiment datasets across diverse robots, scenes, sensors, and labels
papers.method: transformer-based diffusion policy supporting language and goal-image conditioning, flexible observations, and finetuning to new embodiments
papers.task: generalist robot manipulation policy learning
papers.novelty: open generalist policy recipe with flexible observation/action spaces and broad finetuning support
papers.project_relevance: Baseline for Policy, Observation, ActionDistribution, GoalImageCondition, and embodiment adaptation.

papers.title: OpenVLA
papers.data: 970k robot manipulation trajectories from Open X-Embodiment
papers.method: 7B VLA built from a Prismatic VLM, SigLIP/DINOv2 fused visual encoder, Llama 2 backbone, and tokenized robot actions
papers.task: open-source generalist robot manipulation and finetuning to new robot setups
papers.novelty: first broadly usable open-source 7B VLA with released checkpoints, training pipeline, and PEFT/quantization support
papers.project_relevance: Baseline for VLA policy execution, generated-task transfer, action-token interface, and finetuning experiments.

papers.title: pi0
papers.data: large robot interaction mixture spanning open-source data and proprietary dexterous data collected across 8 robot platforms
papers.method: VLA flow model initialized from a 3B VLM and augmented with continuous high-frequency action outputs via flow matching
papers.task: general robot control across dexterous, long-horizon, multi-stage real-world tasks
papers.novelty: uses continuous flow-matching action generation to scale VLM-backed robot policies to dexterous control
papers.project_relevance: Sets a high demo-quality target for robot execution, deformable manipulation, long-horizon interaction, and continuous action generation.

papers.title: VLA-R1
papers.data: reasoning-augmented VLA training examples
papers.method: explicit reasoning enhancement for VLA
papers.task: vision-language-action reasoning and manipulation
papers.novelty: adds reasoning traces/planning to VLA action generation
papers.project_relevance: bridges target-task predicates and action selection

papers.title: World Action Models
papers.data: survey/position paper over VLA and world-model research
papers.method: formal definition of action-conditioned world modeling
papers.task: model physical evolution under interventions
papers.novelty: separates reactive VLA from intervention-aware world-action modeling
papers.project_relevance: aligns directly with target-task StateTransition and ValidationReport

papers.title: Physically Viable World Models
papers.data: conceptual/query-conditioned embodied AI framework
papers.method: physically viable transition model for intervention queries
papers.task: answer action-outcome queries under physical structure
papers.novelty: requires world models to preserve intervention-relevant physical structure
papers.project_relevance: supports the target representation as a query-conditioned physical interface

papers.title: GR00T N1
papers.data: large mixed humanoid/robot datasets plus simulation benchmark evaluations and released model artifacts
papers.method: open foundation model for humanoid robots with reasoning and action components trained on diverse robot data
papers.task: generalist humanoid robot control under language and visual instructions
papers.novelty: one of the first open humanoid foundation models with official weights and reproducible release path
papers.project_relevance: Important VLA baseline for humanoid embodiments and synthetic-data-to-policy evaluation.

papers.title: Green-VLA
papers.data: 3000 hours of demonstrations, Simpler BRIDGE WidowX, CALVIN ABC-D, and real-robot evaluations
papers.method: five-stage VLA curriculum with multimodal grounding, multi-embodiment pretraining, embodiment adaptation, and RL policy alignment
papers.task: generalist robot control across humanoids, mobile manipulators, and fixed-base arms
papers.novelty: combines staged training, embodiment-aware actions, OOD detection, and RL alignment for real deployment
papers.project_relevance: Useful systems reference for staged VLA training and safety-aware execution.

papers.title: XR-1
papers.data: large-scale cross-embodiment robot datasets plus more than 14,000 rollouts on six robot embodiments and 120+ tasks
papers.method: Unified Vision-Motion Codes learned by dual-branch VQ-VAE with three-stage VLA training
papers.task: versatile robot manipulation across diverse embodiments and environments
papers.novelty: aligns visual dynamics and robot motion into a shared intermediate code for scalable VLA learning
papers.project_relevance: Strong VLA reference for cross-embodiment action representation and real rollout quality.

papers.title: TwinVLA
papers.data: single-arm public robot data plus bimanual real-world and simulation task evaluations
papers.method: modular composition of two pretrained single-arm VLA policies into a coordinated bimanual policy
papers.task: data-efficient bimanual manipulation from vision-language instructions
papers.novelty: reuses single-arm data and policies instead of requiring full bimanual pretraining
papers.project_relevance: Good baseline for bimanual task generation and policy-evaluation suites.

papers.title: MMaDA-VLA
papers.data: simulation benchmarks and real-world robot tasks including LIBERO and CALVIN-style evaluations
papers.method: native discrete diffusion VLA that jointly denoises language, images, future observations, and action chunks
papers.task: language-conditioned robot manipulation with parallel action and future-observation generation
papers.novelty: unifies multimodal instruction understanding, future visual generation, and action prediction in one diffusion backbone
papers.project_relevance: Relevant to world-action interfaces because it predicts future visual outcomes and actions jointly.

papers.title: MolmoAct2
papers.data: Molmo 2-ER reasoning corpus, MolmoAct2-Bimanual YAM, filtered DROID Franka, SO100/101, Bridge, and Open X-Embodiment-derived robot data
papers.method: embodied-reasoning VLM with a KV-cache bridge to a flow-matching action expert plus adaptive-depth reasoning and an open action tokenizer
papers.task: open real-world robot manipulation with reasoning-heavy single-arm and bimanual control
papers.novelty: combines open embodied reasoning, open action tokenization, low-cost/bimanual data, and broad release artifacts into a deployment-oriented VLA stack
papers.project_relevance: Strong open baseline for reasoning-to-action transfer, bimanual manipulation, and low-cost embodiment deployment.

papers.title: Cosmos-Predict2.5: A World Foundation Model for Physical AI
papers.data: 200 million training video clips and official world-model release artifacts for physical-AI prediction
papers.method: large action-conditioned world foundation model for future physical-scene prediction
papers.task: predict physically meaningful future observations for control, planning, and simulation-like use cases
papers.novelty: positions large-scale predictive world modeling directly as physical-AI infrastructure rather than generic video synthesis
papers.project_relevance: Strong world-model baseline for action-conditioned rollout prediction and control-facing embodied generation.

papers.title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
papers.data: moderate-scale robot interaction dataset driving an action-conditioned video world model that supports multiple manipulation tasks and an interactive online demo.
papers.method: uses consistency models for both latent dynamics prediction and image decoding to build a fast, stable action-conditioned world simulator for closed-loop robot policy training and evaluation.
papers.task: simulate long-horizon robot interaction rollouts quickly enough and stably enough that policies can be trained and evaluated inside the learned world model.
papers.novelty: targets the missing middle ground between slow pixel-rollout world models and physics engines by treating the learned model itself as an interactive simulator for policy loops.
papers.project_relevance: High-value reference for learned world simulators that can sit directly inside embodied training and evaluation loops rather than only generating showcase videos.

papers.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
papers.data: LIBERO-Plus and real-robot manipulation evaluations paired with a world-action prior and public Hugging Face model release.
papers.method: injects a World-Action Model into a VLA through latent steering at the perception layer and action steering at the trajectory/action layer.
papers.task: improve manipulation policy quality by giving VLA policies compact anticipatory priors about scene evolution and motion.
papers.novelty: shows a concrete way to route world-model priors into a VLA without forcing slow explicit pixel rollouts at action time.
papers.project_relevance: Excellent fit for the world-action-model branch because it operationalizes how a learned world prior can improve a deployed VLA policy.

papers.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
papers.data: large-scale egocentric video pretraining paired with robot-control evaluation and public code for a latent world-action model.
papers.method: learns a latent world-action model that carries future-aware interaction structure from egocentric videos into a deployable action prior without explicit pixel rollout at test time.
papers.task: improve robot control by giving policies future-aware latent dynamics and task-progress signals extracted from dense video structure.
papers.novelty: keeps the predictive benefits of world modeling while moving the reasoning substrate from expensive pixel prediction into a compact latent control interface.
papers.project_relevance: Useful anchor for compact world-action priors that keep embodied reasoning in the control loop without paying full pixel-rollout cost.

papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.data: omnimodal physical-AI release surface spanning language, image, video, audio, and action sequences with public model cards and source code.
papers.method: unified mixture-of-transformers world-model family that jointly processes and generates multimodal physical-world sequences, subsuming VLMs, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models.
papers.task: support understanding, generation, simulation, and action inside one omnimodal world-model stack for physical AI use cases.
papers.novelty: collapses several previously separate embodied model classes into one omnimodal world-model family with flexible input-output configurations.
papers.project_relevance: High-impact anchor for world-model systems that unify perception, simulation, and action rather than treating them as separate modules.

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
papers.data: More than 50 hours of IsaacLab simulation and fewer than 2.5 hours of real dexterous demonstrations.
papers.method: Mask-space dynamics prediction from 23-DoF actions followed by ControlNet-augmented photorealistic video rendering.
papers.task: Action-conditioned long-horizon prediction and policy evaluation for dexterous manipulation.
papers.novelty: Uses segmentation masks as a low-gap sim-to-real dynamics interface that preserves fine-grained joint controllability.
papers.project_relevance: Direct design and evaluation reference for controllable physical-world rollouts.

papers.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
papers.data: 22 simulated MetaWorld/RLBench tasks and eight Franka real-world tasks with RGB-D/point-cloud observations.
papers.method: 3D-to-2D positional alignment, geometry-centric current/future point-cloud pretraining, and layer-wise temporal action modeling.
papers.task: Geometry- and dynamics-aware language-conditioned robot manipulation.
papers.novelty: Directly encodes point clouds with a pretrained 2D encoder while forecasting future geometry and structured action chunks.
papers.project_relevance: Strong baseline linking spatial state evolution to executable VLA actions.

papers.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.data: Large-scale video-action pretraining corpus plus simulation and real-robot manipulation evaluations reported by the authors.
papers.method: Semantic visual-action tokenizer, native causal pretraining, sparse MoE backbone, and asynchronous closed-loop forward-dynamics inference.
papers.task: Generalizable real-time robot control through joint video and action prediction.
papers.novelty: Builds the video-action stack from scratch for embodiment rather than retrofitting a bidirectional reconstruction video generator.
papers.project_relevance: Field-shaping reference for predictive dynamics, action generation, latency, and observation re-grounding in one control loop.

papers.title: VLA-JEPA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Model with Latent World Model
papers.data: SSV2, DROID, BridgeV2, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and real-world manipulation tasks
papers.method: leakage-free JEPA future-latent prediction from current-only observations followed by VLA action-head fine-tuning
papers.task: language-conditioned manipulation with training-time latent world-model supervision and direct inference-time action prediction
papers.novelty: learns action-relevant future states without pixel prediction, future-input leakage, or an inference-time world-model branch
papers.project_relevance: Clean baseline for FutureLatentTarget, LeakageGuard, ActionHead, and TrainingOnlyWorldModel design.

papers.title: Geometry-aware 4D Video Generation for Robot Manipulation
papers.data: multi-view RGB-D manipulation sequences with pointmaps, robot poses, simulated tasks, and real-world examples
papers.method: dual-view video diffusion with cross-attention and pointmap supervision followed by off-the-shelf 6-DoF pose tracking
papers.task: generate geometrically aligned future RGB-D videos and recover executable end-effector trajectories
papers.novelty: combines temporal generation with cross-view metric geometry so generated futures can drive downstream robot manipulation
papers.project_relevance: Direct reference for CameraView, DepthFrame, PointMap, CrossViewCorrespondence, and EndEffectorPose.

papers.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
papers.data: DROID, RLBench, Bridge, RT-1, and real UF ARM manipulation tasks
papers.method: dense 4D correspondence distillation into a video DiT followed by adaptive grounding, tracking correction, and inverse kinematics
papers.task: generate geometry-consistent future videos and convert them into executable simulated and real robot trajectories
papers.novelty: uses a geometry teacher only during training to improve rollout correspondence without extra inference cost
papers.project_relevance: Strong source for GeometryTeacher, CorrespondenceField, TrackingCorrection, and InverseKinematics fields.

papers.title: ORV: 4D Occupancy-centric Robot Video Generation
papers.data: ORV-Data plus BridgeV2, DROID, and RT-1 with 4D semantic occupancy, RGB video, robot actions, and multiple views
papers.method: Action-Expert AdaLN for chunked 7-DoF controls plus rendered 4D occupancy soft guidance in video diffusion
papers.task: generate controllable single- and multi-view robot videos for prediction, planning, policy learning, and sim-to-real augmentation
papers.novelty: uses dense semantic occupancy to bridge sparse robot controls and pixel generation while supporting multiview consistency
papers.project_relevance: Provides reusable ActionChunk, SemanticOccupancy4D, ViewSet, SimToRealTransfer, and ControlAlignment fields.

papers.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
papers.data: mixed robot and VQA pretraining; R1 Lite/Pro, BEHAVIOR-1K, DROID, LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and SimplerEnv-Bridge evaluation
papers.method: single autoregressive decoder with cross-embodiment ActionCodec, native reasoning/action tokens, and visual memory
papers.task: generalist closed-loop language-conditioned manipulation across embodiments and horizons
papers.novelty: unifies reasoning and robot action in one token stream rather than attaching a separately trained action expert
papers.project_relevance: Strong baseline for unified reasoning-action tokens, readable traces, memory, and cross-embodiment control.

papers.title: StellaVLA: In-Context Structured Demonstration for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.data: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, VLA-Arena, and real-robot robot/human/XR demonstrations
papers.method: retrieved trajectory converted into task plans, subgoals, and verbalized 3D motion for in-context action guidance
papers.task: test-time VLA adaptation under OOD scenes, viewpoints, objects, and embodiments
papers.novelty: uses one structured cross-embodiment demonstration for adaptation without fine-tuning or added action-path latency
papers.project_relevance: Reusable schema for structured demonstrations and cross-embodiment test-time adaptation.

papers.title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
papers.data: LIBERO-Plus-style simulation and real-world manipulation trajectories
papers.method: masked trajectory prediction with future-latent prediction, inverse action reconstruction, and a compact Mixture-of-Transformers
papers.task: efficient language-conditioned robot manipulation
papers.novelty: learns compact action-grounded predictive latents without pixel generation or large embodied pretraining
papers.project_relevance: Efficient latent-world baseline for testing whether pixel prediction is necessary for policy learning.

papers.title: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
papers.data: LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real R1 Pro manipulation
papers.method: World Adapter shared by future-video denoising and action generation, with the video branch removed at deployment
papers.task: efficient VLA control enhanced by training-time visual world modeling
papers.novelty: forces fixed world tokens to carry dynamics information through exclusive shared conditioning without online video inference
papers.project_relevance: Direct reference for distilling generative dynamics supervision into an efficient executable policy.

papers.title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
papers.data: LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world bimanual manipulation
papers.method: spatially structured current-future V-JEPA target with a predictor shared by latent transition and continuous action generation
papers.task: distribution-robust language-conditioned manipulation
papers.novelty: preserves dense patch correspondence while directly coupling latent transition supervision to action features
papers.project_relevance: High-value dense latent WAM baseline compatible with pretrained VLA pathways.

papers.title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
papers.data: three million physics-annotated manipulation clips plus released SFT data and EZS-Bench
papers.method: 14B diffusion transformer with physics-aware DPO, decoupled discriminators and spatial action context blocks
papers.task: action-controllable zero-shot robot future generation
papers.novelty: decoupled physics/quality preference alignment with cross-embodiment spatial action injection
papers.project_relevance: Open action-to-video world-model and zero-shot physical evaluation baseline.

papers.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.data: 2.5M multi-source, multi-view robotic clips
papers.method: Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention, camera-aware Geo-RoPE and Latent 3D-REPA on a flow-matching video DiT
papers.task: multi-view future generation for prediction, planning and policy post-training
papers.novelty: joint explicit inter-view communication and geometric representation alignment
papers.project_relevance: Multi-camera world-action baseline with geometry-consistency validation.

papers.title: Gemini Robotics 2
papers.data: Undisclosed training mixture; official evaluation covers humanoid whole-body control, bi-arm dexterity, cross-embodiment transfer, multi-robot collaboration, and embodied reasoning.
papers.method: Gemini-based VLA family with whole-body control, an on-device variant, and ER 2 high-level embodied reasoning that hands execution to lower-level policies.
papers.task: Perform dexterous, whole-body, multi-stage and coordinated physical tasks across robot forms.
papers.novelty: Unifies whole-body humanoid control, cross-embodiment dexterity, local deployment and multi-robot orchestration in one official robotics family.
papers.project_relevance: High-value reference for hierarchical VLA/ER decomposition, whole-body action interfaces and multi-robot coordination.

papers.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
papers.data: Heterogeneous OXE robot video, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM, G1 humanoid and egocentric human video.
papers.method: Two-stage curriculum learns latent-action physical priors from unlabeled video, then grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero/few-shot deployment.
papers.task: Predict action-conditioned futures across embodiments for planning, evaluation and policy improvement.
papers.novelty: Reconciles robot and human action spaces through end-effector, language and latent-action interfaces in one cross-embodiment video world model.
papers.project_relevance: Direct open reference for universal action schemas, cross-embodiment dynamics and policy-in-the-loop learned simulation.

papers.title: EWMBench
papers.data: embodied world model evaluation scenarios
papers.method: multi-dimensional embodied world-model benchmark
papers.task: evaluate scene, motion, semantic and interaction consistency
papers.novelty: moves world-model evaluation beyond pixel/video quality
papers.project_relevance: evaluation philosophy for interactive embodied generation benchmark

papers.title: WorldScore
papers.data: world generation outputs and scoring dimensions
papers.method: unified benchmark for world generation
papers.task: score quality, consistency, controllability and interactivity
papers.novelty: multi-dimensional evaluation for generated worlds
papers.project_relevance: baseline for interactive embodied generation benchmark metrics

papers.title: RoboVerse
papers.data: unified tasks, assets, scenes, trajectories, and standardized imitation/RL benchmarks for robot learning
papers.method: platform-level dataset and benchmark infrastructure with standardized training/evaluation protocols and baselines
papers.task: scalable and generalizable robot learning evaluation across tasks and embodiments
papers.novelty: unifies platform, dataset, task assets, and benchmark protocols for scalable robot learning
papers.project_relevance: Useful for benchmark packaging, generated-task evaluation, policy baselines, and trajectory/data schema design.

papers.title: OpenEQA
papers.data: embodied question-answering benchmark over physical/scanned environments
papers.method: open-vocabulary embodied QA benchmark and LLM-Match answer evaluation protocol
papers.task: answer natural-language questions about an embodied environment
papers.novelty: modern open-vocabulary embodied QA benchmark for evaluating environment understanding
papers.project_relevance: downstream benchmark for testing whether generated interactive environments preserve object identity, spatial relations, and semantic affordances

papers.title: WorldArena
papers.data: public benchmark, leaderboard, dataset, and challenge for embodied world models
papers.method: perception and functional-utility benchmark with 16 numerical video metrics, task-functionality evaluation, human judgment, and EWMScore
papers.task: evaluate embodied world models as perceptual predictors, synthetic data engines, policy evaluators, and action planners
papers.novelty: ties world-model evaluation to functional embodied utility rather than video quality alone
papers.project_relevance: Important evaluation target for our interactive embodied world generator and world-model branches.

papers.title: World-in-World
papers.data: closed-loop world-model benchmark tasks, unified action API, code, leaderboard, and demos
papers.method: closed-loop evaluation platform where planners propose actions and world models predict future observations inside task loops
papers.task: evaluate visual world models by embodied utility in closed-loop interaction
papers.novelty: evaluates world models under recursive agent-world interaction rather than one-step visual prediction
papers.project_relevance: Provides a harness template for action-conditioned rollout evaluation and closed-loop generated-world testing.

papers.title: Ctrl-World
papers.data: policy-in-the-loop rollouts and real-world/world-model comparisons for generalist robot policies
papers.method: controllable world-model evaluation designed to let generalist robot policies roll out actions inside imagination space
papers.task: evaluate whether world models support policy-in-the-loop manipulation rollouts
papers.novelty: centers evaluation on policy utility and rollout control rather than passive generation quality
papers.project_relevance: Useful benchmark design for world-action model validators and imagined rollout tests.

papers.title: WorldArena 2.0
papers.data: expanded embodied world-model benchmark with visuotactile, simulated, and real-world evaluation surfaces plus public leaderboard infrastructure
papers.method: benchmark extension that evaluates world models across modality, functionality, and platform with perceptual metrics and downstream embodied utility tests
papers.task: evaluate embodied world models as perceptual predictors, data engines, policy evaluators, action planners, and interactive RL environments
papers.novelty: extends WorldArena from vision-only simulator-centric evaluation toward visuotactile, policy-optimization, and cross-platform embodied testing
papers.project_relevance: Direct evaluation target for closed-loop embodied generation, world-action models, and simulator-backed policy learning.

papers.title: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.data: multi-benchmark VLA evaluation adapters, result reporting, and active official repository coverage
papers.method: unified orchestration harness for running VLA models across multiple benchmark suites
papers.task: evaluate VLA models consistently across benchmarks and execution stacks
papers.novelty: standardizes VLA benchmarking infrastructure instead of leaving evaluation fragmented across project-specific scripts
papers.project_relevance: High-value infrastructure reference for evaluation adapters, result schemas, and standardized VLA benchmarking.

papers.title: VLA-REPLICA: A Low-Cost, Reproducible Benchmark for Real-World Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.data: low-cost real-world VLA benchmark setup with 10 tasks, demonstration data, and reproducibility checks across independently built setups
papers.method: standardized physical setup and evaluation protocol for reproducible real-world VLA benchmarking
papers.task: measure VLA performance in a replicable real-world robot setting with ID and OOD evaluation
papers.novelty: prioritizes affordability and cross-site reproducibility in real-world VLA evaluation
papers.project_relevance: Strong real-world evaluation template for low-cost embodied testing and reproducible action-model benchmarking.

papers.title: RoboWM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating World Models in Robotic Manipulation
papers.data: manipulation-centric benchmark that turns generated human-hand and robotic manipulation videos into embodied action sequences and validates them through execution in standardized manipulation scenarios
papers.method: convert generated behaviors into executable action sequences, replay them in a robotics execution loop, and score physically executable task completion with failure-mode analysis
papers.task: evaluate whether video world-model predictions can be translated into executable manipulation actions that still complete the intended task
papers.novelty: moves world-model evaluation from visual plausibility to embodiment-grounded action executability for robotic manipulation
papers.project_relevance: Direct benchmark reference for whether generated embodied futures are actionable enough for manipulation-policy learning and validation.

papers.title: VLA-Arena: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.data: 170 tasks across 11 specialized suites with three difficulty levels, plus VLA-Arena-S/M/L datasets and orthogonal language and visual perturbation settings
papers.method: structured benchmark design over task structure, language command, and visual observation axes with unified tooling for task modeling, training, and automated evaluation
papers.task: systematically benchmark VLA robustness, safety, extrapolation, distractor handling, and long-horizon composition under controlled perturbations
papers.novelty: separates VLA capability-frontier measurement into orthogonal structure/language/visual axes instead of collapsing everything into one aggregate success rate
papers.project_relevance: Strong infrastructure reference for evaluation schemas, perturbation taxonomies, and task-difficulty ladders for embodied policy assessment.

papers.title: Colosseum V2: Benchmarking Generalization for Vision Language Action Models
papers.data: large-scale ManiSkill benchmark with 28 tasks spanning 13 categories, two robot morphologies, and controlled in-domain/out-of-domain perturbation settings
papers.method: GPU-parallelized simulation benchmark that probes VLA generalization along visual, language, and action axes and checks ecological validity against real-world metrics
papers.task: measure how VLA manipulation performance degrades under distribution shift and whether simulation rankings track real-world robustness
papers.novelty: pushes VLA evaluation beyond nominal zero-shot perception into controlled perturbation-based generalization measurement with simulation-to-real correlation checks
papers.project_relevance: Useful benchmark template for large-scale, perturbation-aware embodied policy evaluation and simulation-to-real validation.

papers.title: MiraBench: Evaluating Action-Conditioned Reliability in Robotic World Models
papers.data: human-annotated corpus with 16k+ judgments covering tasks, failure categories, and 12 representative robotic-world-model configurations
papers.method: hierarchical diagnostic benchmark over physics adherence, action-following fidelity, and optimism-bias detection for action-conditioned robotic world models
papers.task: test whether action-conditioned robotic world models are physically consistent, obey task-relevant actions, and avoid optimistic false-success predictions
papers.novelty: defines action-conditioned reliability as a first-class target rather than assuming image fidelity stands in for robotic faithfulness
papers.project_relevance: Directly relevant to evaluating whether generated futures are faithful control simulators rather than merely plausible videos.

papers.title: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
papers.data: 330k video clips, 2.1k selected high-quality samples, and 4.9k test tasks spanning varied perspectives, weather, and scenes
papers.method: unified action-generation framework that standardizes interaction control across modalities and scores world models on visual generation, trajectory following, and memory with nine metrics
papers.task: train and test interactive world models on distance perception, action control, camera control, trajectory following, and memory across diverse scenes
papers.novelty: turns interactive world-model evaluation into a multi-input, action-space-unified benchmark instead of model-specific camera-control demos
papers.project_relevance: High-value benchmark for first-person interactive world-model evaluation, camera control, memory, and multi-scene action responsiveness.

papers.title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation
papers.data: 289 multi-turn test cases and 1,058 interaction turns covering navigation, subject action, event editing, and perspective switching
papers.method: comprehensive multi-turn benchmark with 22 automatic sub-metrics across video quality, setting adherence, interaction adherence, consistency, and physics compliance
papers.task: evaluate whether interactive video world models sustain coherent multi-turn behavior under heterogeneous control interfaces
papers.novelty: brings multi-turn interaction and heterogeneous control-interface unification into one benchmark rather than one-step or single-axis evaluation
papers.project_relevance: Strong benchmark reference for multi-turn interaction fidelity and physics-compliance evaluation in interactive world generation.

papers.title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
papers.data: 500 standardized evaluation cases built from 100 test images and 15 shared action sequences across first-person, third-person, real, and stylized scenes
papers.method: shared WASD-style action vocabulary, cross-model action mapping, and modular metrics for visual quality, control alignment, and world consistency, paired with the World Model Arena website
papers.task: compare interactive image-to-video world models under identical scenes and identical action sequences
papers.novelty: creates the first common playing field for interactive image-to-video world models with standardized scenes, controls, and reusable evaluation toolkit
papers.project_relevance: Important benchmark and online-comparison reference for standardized interactive world-generation evaluation.

papers.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
papers.data: 1,000 long videos spanning 400 robotics, 400 gaming, and 200 general real-world videos
papers.method: triathlon-style benchmark with physical, geometry, and interaction tracks using segmentation-based judges, Gaussian-splatting diagnostics, and action-following checks
papers.task: diagnose long-video world models on physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity across multiple downstream domains
papers.novelty: unifies physical, geometric, and interaction diagnostics across robotics, gaming, and open-domain world-model scenarios rather than isolating one dimension
papers.project_relevance: Strong cross-domain benchmark for long-horizon world-model evaluation with direct relevance to robotics and interactive control.

papers.title: WorldBench: Disambiguating Physics for Diagnostic Evaluation of World Models
papers.data: video benchmark with 425 configurations over motion physics, object permanence, support relations, and scale/perspective, plus a language subset for VLM evaluation
papers.method: disentangled physics benchmark that scores future predictions against simulated ground-truth physical outcomes using segmentation-based comparison and concept-specific scenarios
papers.task: diagnose whether world models and VLMs understand specific physical concepts rather than merely producing visually plausible futures
papers.novelty: disentangles physical concepts into more diagnostic tests instead of entangled holistic video-quality proxies
papers.project_relevance: Useful physics-diagnostic benchmark for checking whether world models preserve support, permanence, and motion rules relevant to executable embodied worlds.

papers.title: Rethinking Video Generation Model for the Embodied World
papers.data: RBench with 650 image-text cases across five tasks and four embodiments, plus RoVid-X with 4M annotated 720p clips over 1,300+ skills
papers.method: nine-indicator embodied video evaluation paired with a four-stage robot-video collection, filtering, segmentation, and annotation pipeline
papers.task: evaluate task correctness, physical plausibility, action completeness, and visual fidelity of robot-oriented video generators and provide training data
papers.novelty: couples a reproducible embodied video benchmark with a large multi-embodiment physically annotated training corpus and public leaderboard
papers.project_relevance: Direct evaluator and data-source reference for generated physical-world consistency and action-aligned video.

papers.title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
papers.data: 230K+ indoor environments, 130K objects, 48K manipulable objects, 42M stable grasps, and eight benchmark tasks
papers.method: simulator-agnostic scene and asset normalization, grasp generation, task configuration, rollout, and evaluation for MuJoCo, Isaac, and ManiSkill
papers.task: train and evaluate navigation, static/mobile manipulation, and multi-room policies under controlled long-tail variation
papers.novelty: unifies very large scene, object, grasp, task, adapter, and benchmark resources in one open cross-simulator ecosystem
papers.project_relevance: Direct executable-world source for SceneFamily, ObjectAsset, StableGrasp, SimulatorAdapter, and TaskConfig schemas.

papers.title: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
papers.data: 128,892 clips, 2,826 hours, 10,428 source videos, 649,597 annotation segments, and 982 loop/revisit panoramas
papers.method: multi-source long-video curation with camera trajectories and hierarchical temporally grounded scene, motion, and camera annotations
papers.task: pretrain long-horizon camera-controllable and persistent interactive world models
papers.novelty: combines long duration, released trajectories, grounded semantics, and loop/revisit supervision at corpus scale
papers.project_relevance: Long-horizon trajectory and revisit substrate for persistent spatial-memory and drift evaluation.

papers.title: PBench: A Physical AI Benchmark for World Models
papers.data: 1,044 image/prompt samples and 5,636 manually corrected QA pairs across six Physical AI domains
papers.method: ontology-grounded video QA domain score combined with eight VBench quality metrics
papers.task: evaluate physical-domain correctness and visual quality of world-model videos
papers.novelty: pairs physical ontology QA with video quality across AV, robotics, industry, physics, human and commonsense domains
papers.project_relevance: Reusable physical ontology and separate domain/quality scores for embodied world evaluation.

papers.title: PAI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark For Physical AI
papers.data: 2,808 real-world cases across driving, robotics, smart-space and egocentric domains
papers.method: three-task suite for generation, conditional generation and physical video understanding
papers.task: evaluate perception and prediction capabilities of Physical AI models
papers.novelty: unifies generated futures, spatially controlled generation and understanding across physical domains
papers.project_relevance: Umbrella scorecard for generation, conditional generation and understanding.

papers.title: PhysBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Physical World Understanding
papers.data: 10,002 interleaved image-video-text entries across 19 physical-world subclasses
papers.method: multimodal multiple-choice benchmark plus specialist-tool-augmented PhysAgent
papers.task: evaluate physical properties, relations, scenes and dynamics understanding
papers.novelty: large physical-understanding diagnostic across 75 VLMs with error and scaling analysis
papers.project_relevance: Upstream physical-reasoning gate for executable and action models.

papers.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
papers.data: 50 scenarios across eight physical-mechanism groups, split into 25 calibration cases and 25 support-coverage cases.
papers.method: Repeated rollouts are mapped to terminal outcomes and scored separately for valid-support recovery and probability-mass calibration.
papers.task: Evaluate whether stochastic video world models represent which physical futures are possible and how likely they are.
papers.novelty: Moves evaluation from one plausible rollout to the full induced distribution over possible terminal futures.
papers.project_relevance: Provides PossibleOutcome, OutcomeProbability, SupportCoverage and CalibrationError fields for stochastic physical-world evaluation.

papers.title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
papers.data: 100 reference scenes with three leave-and-return trajectories each, producing 300 instances across appearance, identity, geometry, and persistent-state criteria.
papers.method: MemoryGain and Normalized Memory Ratio compare revisits with gap-matched non-revisit and short-range controls from the same rollout.
papers.task: Measure revisit-specific memory in interactive video world models without rewarding static or failed-motion rollouts.
papers.novelty: Introduces same-rollout relative calibration that discounts generic temporal stability and the slow-motion shortcut.
papers.project_relevance: Direct metric reference for persistent world state, return consistency and shortcut-resistant long-horizon evaluation.
